# ForgeGrowth

> The estate's growth organ. It turns a real fallforgemint scorecard receipt into launch copy under two
> hard rules: (1) every number an ad states must be a value on the receipt, or the ad is REFUSED
> (fabrication is structurally impossible); (2) every external publish is queued behind a human key and
> never auto-executed. Proof-not-hype. Witness-gated, zero dependencies, runs offline.

## What it is
- Live: https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/forgegrowth/
- forgegrowth.mjs — verifyReceipt, backedFacts, auditAd (the anti-fabrication + anti-hype gate),
  generateAd, generateCopy, planPublish (queues external posts as PENDING_KEY, executes nothing).
- Witness mutation gate CLEAN; unit tests cover the gate against tampered receipts and fabricated ads.

## Provenance
- Consumes fallforgemint scorecard receipts; Konomi architecture created by Thomas Frumkin. MIT.
